Owner already synced these to root; this file makes them survive master rebuilds. estimate=true (현대해상 생명장기 leg): provenance/designer 음영. null_dangi.cells: [code, quarter, item] whose derived single-quarter 값_당분기 is forced to null while 값 (연누계) is kept -- for single quarters whose two cumulatives come from different disclosure vintages (a blank cell beats a wrong cell; build_root_masters._pl_null_dangi_keys). set_dangi.cells: [code, quarter, item, value, source] -- the single-quarter 값_당분기 is forced to the THREE-MONTH value printed in the filing (kept: 값 YTD), for single quarters whose two cumulatives come from different disclosure vintages (build_root_masters._pl_set_dangi_values; a key in null_dangi and set_dangi is refused).
